verse.verse_2: and obeys its Lord as it must,
verse.verse_4: and casts out all that is within it and becomes empty;
verse.verse_5: and obeys its Lord as it must,
verse.verse_6: O man, having striven hard towards your Lord, you shall meet Him:
verse.verse_7: he who is given his record in his right hand
verse.verse_9: and he shall return to his people, joyfully,
verse.verse_10: but as for him whose record shall be given to him from behind his back,
verse.verse_11: he will pray for utter destruction
verse.verse_12: and he will enter the blazing flame.
verse.verse_13: He used to be happy with his own people;
verse.verse_14: for he never thought that he would have to return [to God].
verse.verse_15: But he will indeed! His Lord was ever watching him.
verse.verse_16: I swear by the glow of sunset,
verse.verse_17: by the night and what it covers,
verse.verse_18: and the moon when it grows full,
verse.verse_19: you will progress from stage to stage.
verse.verse_20: What is wrong with them that they do not believe?
verse.verse_21: When the Quran is read to them, why do they not fall to their knees?
verse.verse_22: Indeed, those who are bent on denying the truth reject it --
verse.verse_23: God is quite aware of what they are storing in their hearts.
verse.verse_24: Therefore, give them the news of a painful punishment.
verse.verse_25: But for those who believe and do good works; for them there shall be a never-ending reward.
